class CSCA_Scene_Skill_Shop < Scene_MenuBase
  def start
    super
    create_help_window
    create_gold_window
    create_command_window
    create_dummy_window
    create_status_window
    create_buy_window
    @shoptime = 0
    @has_shopped = false
    create_talk_window
    create_desc_window
    create_shop_background
    create_shopkeeper
    create_images
    @leave_shop = false
    @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::GREET) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    @shoptime = Galv_Shopkeeper::FRAME_TIME
  end
  
  def create_desc_window
    wx = @buy_window.x
    wy = @buy_window.y
    ww = @buy_window.width
    wh = @buy_window.height
    @desc_window = Window_SkillDesc.new(wx, wy, ww, wh)
    @desc_window.viewport = @viewport
    @desc_window.hide
  end
  
  def create_talk_window
    @talk_window = Window_Help.new
    @talk_window.viewport = @viewport
    @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[0])
    @help_window.hide
  end
  
  # OVERWRITE
  def create_dummy_window
    wx = Graphics.width - 304
    wy = @command_window.y + @command_window.height
    wh = Graphics.height - wy - @gold_window.height * 2
    ww = Graphics.width - wx
    @dummy_window = Window_Base.new(wx, wy, ww, wh)
    @dummy_window.viewport = @viewport
  end
  
  # OVERWRITE
  def create_buy_window
    wy = @dummy_window.y
    wh = @dummy_window.height
    @buy_window = CSCA_Window_SkillShopBuy.new(0, wy, wh, @goods)
    @buy_window.viewport = @viewport
    @buy_window.help_window = @help_window
    @buy_window.status_window = @status_window
    @buy_window.desc_window = @desc_window
    @buy_window.hide
    @buy_window.set_handler(:ok,     method(:on_buy_ok))
    @buy_window.set_handler(:cancel, method(:on_buy_cancel))
    @buy_window.x = Graphics.width - @buy_window.width
  end
  
  # OVERWRITE
  def create_status_window
    wx = @dummy_window.x
    wy = @dummy_window.y + @dummy_window.height
    ww = @dummy_window.width
    wh = Graphics.height - @dummy_window.height - @dummy_window.y
    @status_window = CSCA_Window_SkillShopStatus.new(wx, wy, ww, wh)
    @status_window.viewport = @viewport
    @status_window.hide
    @status_window.set_handler(:ok,     method(:on_number_ok))
    @status_window.set_handler(:cancel, method(:on_number_cancel))
  end
  
  def create_shopkeeper
    @keeper = Sprite.new
    @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    @keeper.y = Graphics.height - @keeper.bitmap.height
  end
  
  def create_images
    @dkey = Sprite.new
    @dkey.opacity = 0
    @dkey.bitmap = Cache.system(Galv_Shopkeeper::D_IMAGE) rescue Cache.system("")
    @dkey.y = Graphics.height - @dkey.bitmap.height
  end
  
  def create_shop_background
    @shopback = Plane.new
    @shopback.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopback)
  end
  
  # OVERWRITE
  def on_buy_cancel
    @command_window.activate
    @buy_window.hide
    @status_window.hide
    @status_window.item = nil
    @help_window.clear
    if @has_shopped == true
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[3])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    else
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[4])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::DONT_BUY)
    end
    show_talk
    @has_shopped = false
    @dkey.opacity = 0
  end
  
  def activate_buy_window
    @buy_window.money = money
    @buy_window.show.activate
    @status_window.show.unselect
  end

  def command_buy
    @dummy_window.hide
    activate_buy_window
    @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    hide_talk
    @dkey.opacity = 255
    @desc_window.y = @buy_window.y
    @desc_window.height = @buy_window.height
  end
  
  def do_buy(actor, skill)
    $game_party.lose_gold(buying_price)
    $game_actors[actor.id].learn_skill(skill.id)
    @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[1])
    show_talk
    @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::BUY) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    @shoptime = Galv_Shopkeeper::FRAME_TIME
  end
  
  def on_buy_ok
    @item = @buy_window.item
    @buy_window.deactivate
    @status_window.set(@item, buying_price)
    @status_window.show.activate.select(0)
    @dkey.opacity = 0
  end
  
  def on_number_ok
    Sound.play_shop
    do_buy(@status_window.item,@buy_window.item)
    end_input
    @gold_window.refresh
    @status_window.refresh
  end

  def on_number_cancel
    Sound.play_cancel
    end_input
  end

  def end_shopanim
    SceneManager.return if @leave_shop == true
    @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    hide_talk unless @command_window.active
  end
  
  def end_input
    @status_window.unselect
    activate_buy_window
  end

  def show_talk
    @talk_window.show
    @help_window.hide
  end
  
  def hide_talk
    @talk_window.hide
    @help_window.show
  end
  
  def update
    super
    @shoptime -= 1
    end_shopanim if @shoptime == 0
    if @shoptime.odd?
      @shopback.ox += Galv_Shopkeeper::BACKGROUND_SCROLL_X
      @shopback.oy += Galv_Shopkeeper::BACKGROUND_SCROLL_Y
    end
    check_button
    other_poses if $game_system.shop_spose != nil
  end
  
  def check_button
    if @desc_window.visible
      if Input.trigger?(Galv_Shopkeeper::DETAILS_KEY) || Input.trigger?(:B)
        @buy_window.show.activate
        RPG::SE.new(Galv_Shopkeeper::SE2[0], Galv_Shopkeeper::SE2[1], Galv_Shopkeeper::SE2[2]).play
        @desc_window.show_off
        @desc_window.hide
        @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
      end
    elsif @buy_window.active
      if Input.trigger?(Galv_Shopkeeper::DETAILS_KEY)
        return if @buy_window.item.nil?
        @buy_window.hide.deactivate
        @desc_window.refresh(@buy_window.item,0)
        @shoptime = 0
        RPG::SE.new(Galv_Shopkeeper::SE1[0], Galv_Shopkeeper::SE1[1], Galv_Shopkeeper::SE1[2]).play
        @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::SHOW_DETAILS) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
        hide_talk
        @desc_window.show
      end
    end
  end
  
  def other_poses
    case $game_system.shop_spose
    when 0
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[6])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::CANT_BUY) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    when 1
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[7])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::CANT_SELL) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    when 2
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[8])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::MAX_ITEMS) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    when 3
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[10])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::NO_DETAILS) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    when 4
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[11])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::SOLD_OUT) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    end
    show_talk
    @shoptime = Galv_Shopkeeper::FRAME_TIME
    $game_system.shop_spose = nil
  end
  
  def return_scene
    @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[9])
    @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::FAREWELL) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    show_talk
    @shoptime = Galv_Shopkeeper::FRAME_TIME
    @leave_shop = true
    $game_system.shop_selected = 0
  end
  
  def terminate
    super
    @keeper.dispose
    @keeper.bitmap.dispose
    @shopback.dispose
    @dkey.bitmap.dispose
    @dkey.dispose
  end
  
end # Scene_Shop < Scene_MenuBase

class CSCA_Window_SkillShopStatus < Window_Selectable
  
  def set(skill, price)
    @skill = skill
    @price = price
    refresh
  end

  def initialize(x, y, width, height)
    super(x, y, width, height)
    @walk = 0
    @step = 0
    @animtime = 0
    @e_images = {}
    @skill = nil
    @page_index = 0
    refresh
    select(0)
  end
  
  def item_max
    @data ? @data.size : 1
  end
  
  def item
    @data[index]
  end
  
  def item=(item)
    @skill = item
    refresh
  end

  def current_item_enabled?
    enable?(@data[index])
  end

  def enable?(actor)
    for i in 0...actor.skills.size
      if actor.skills[i] == @skill
        return false
      end
    end
    for i in 0...actor.csca_learnable_skills.size
      unless @skill.nil?
        if actor.csca_learnable_skills[i] == @skill.id
          return true
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end

  def refresh
    contents.clear
    make_item_list
    create_contents
    draw_all_items
  end

  def status_members
    $game_party.members[@page_index * page_size, page_size]
  end
  
  def col_max
    return Galv_Shopkeeper::ACTORS_SHOWN
  end
  
  def make_item_list
    @data = []
    $game_party.members.each do |actor|
      item = actor
      if !item.nil?
        @data.push(item)
      end
    end
  end

  def draw_item(index)
    item = @data[index]
    rect = item_rect(index)
    draw_equip_info(Galv_Shopkeeper::ACTORS_X + 5, 40) 
  end
  
  def item_rect(index)
    rect = Rect.new
    rect.width = item_width
    rect.height = item_height - spacing / 2
    rect.x = index % col_max * item_width + (index * Galv_Shopkeeper::ACTORS_SPACE) + Galv_Shopkeeper::ACTORS_X - (index * 40) - 4
    rect.y = index / col_max * item_height + spacing / 2 - 4
    rect
  end

  def item_width
    return 40
  end

  def item_height
    return 60
  end
  
  # OVERWRITE
  def draw_equip_info(x, y)
    status_members.each_with_index do |actor, i|
      draw_actor_equip_info(x + (i * Galv_Shopkeeper::ACTORS_SPACE), y, actor)
    end
  end
  
  # OVERWRITE
  def page_size
    return Galv_Shopkeeper::ACTORS_SHOWN
  end
  
  # OVERWRITE
  def draw_actor_equip_info(x, y, actor)
    draw_character(actor.character_name, actor.character_index, x + 10, y + 11, enable?(actor))
  end
    
  def draw_character(character_name, character_index, x, y, enabled = false)
    return unless character_name
    bitmap = Cache.character(character_name)
    sign = character_name[/^[\!\$]./]
    if sign && sign.include?('$')
      cw = bitmap.width / 3
      ch = bitmap.height / 4
    else
      cw = bitmap.width / 12
      ch = bitmap.height / 8
    end
    n = character_index
    step = 0
    step = @walk if enabled
    src_rect = Rect.new((n%4*3+1+step)*cw, (n/4*4)*ch, cw, ch)
    contents.blt(x - cw / 2, y - ch, bitmap, src_rect)
  end

  def ani_motion
    @animtime += 1
    if @animtime == 10
      case @walk
      when 1; @walk -= 1
      when -1; @walk += 1
      when 0
        if @step == 1
          @walk = -1
          @step = 0
        else
          @walk = 1
          @step = 1
        end
      end
      refresh
      @animtime = 0
    end
  end

  def update
    super
    ani_motion
  end
end

class Window_SkillDesc < Window_Base
  def initialize(x, y, width, height)
    super(x, y, width, height)
    @item = nil
    @shown = false
  end
  
  def refresh(item,type)
    @shown = true
    @item = item
    return if item.nil?
    check_contents_height
    draw_item_name(@item, 0, 0)
    draw_currency_value(get_price, Vocab::currency_unit, 0, 0, contents.width)
    draw_item_stats(0,contents.width)
  end
  
  def get_price
    return @item.skill_price
  end
  
  def show_off
    @shown = false
    self.oy = 0
  end
  
  def item=(item)
    @item = item
    refresh
  end
  
  def check_contents_height
    contents.clear
    ht = self.height
    l = 1
    if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::SKILL_TYPE
      l += 1
    end
    if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::SHOW_COSTS
      if @item.mp_cost != 0
        l += 1
      end
      if @item.tp_cost != 0
        l += 1
      end
    end
    if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::SHOW_SCOPE
      l += 1
    end
    if @item.damage.type != 0
      l += 1
      if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::USE_SPACES
        l += 1
      end
    end
    c = 0
    d = 0
    e = false
    @item.effects.each do |set|
      case set.code
      when 11
        c += 1
        l += 1
        l += 1 if c == 3
        if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::USE_SPACES
          l += 1 if c == 3
        end
      when 12
        c += 1
        l += 1
        l += 1 if c == 3
        if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::USE_SPACES
          l += 1 if c == 3
        end
      when 13
        c += 1
        l += 1
        l += 1 if c == 3
        if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::USE_SPACES
          l += 1 if c == 3
        end
      when 21
        d += 1
        l += 1
        if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::USE_SPACES
          l += 1 if d == 2
        end
      when 22
        d += 1
        l += 1
        if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::USE_SPACES
          l += 1 if d == 2
        end
      when 31
        e = true
        l += 1
      when 32
        e = true
        l += 1
      when 33
        e = true
        l += 1
      when 34
        e = true
        l += 1
      when 42
        l += 1
      end
    end
    if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::USE_SPACES
      l += 1 if e == true
      l += 1
    end
    self.height = line_height * l
    create_contents
    self.height = ht
  end

##########################################################################
  def draw_item_stats(dy, sw)
    dy += 24
    ########
    if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::SKILL_TYPE

        word = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::TEXT_MP

      remove_states = []

        when 1 #---MP---

          icon = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ICON_MDF
        when 6 #---AGI---
          word = Vocab::param(set.data_id)
          icon = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ICON_AGI
        when 7 #---LUK---

          icon = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ICON_LUK

          text = "+" + text + " turns"

        else

        end
        case set.data_id
        when 0 #---HP---
          word = Vocab::param(set.data_id)
          icon = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ICON_HP

          icon = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ICON_MP

        dy += 24
        change_color(system_color)
        draw_text(0, dy, sw/2, 24, buff)

  end

  def cursor_down(wrap = false)
    if self.oy < self.contents.height - self.height
      self.oy += 16
    end
  end

  def cursor_up(wrap = false)
    if self.oy > 0
      self.oy -= 16
    end

    super

    return unless @shown

  end

class CSCA_Scene_Skill_Shop < Scene_MenuBase
  def start
    super
    create_help_window
    create_gold_window
    create_command_window
    create_dummy_window
    create_status_window
    create_buy_window
    @shoptime = 0
    @has_shopped = false
    create_talk_window
    create_desc_window
    create_shop_background
    create_shopkeeper
    create_images
    @leave_shop = false
    @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::GREET) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    @shoptime = Galv_Shopkeeper::FRAME_TIME
  end
 
  def create_desc_window
    wx = @buy_window.x
    wy = @buy_window.y
    ww = @buy_window.width
    wh = Graphics.height - wy
    @desc_window = Window_SkillDesc.new(wx, wy, ww, wh)
    @desc_window.viewport = @viewport
    @desc_window.hide
  end
 
  def create_talk_window
    @talk_window = Window_Help.new
    @talk_window.viewport = @viewport
    @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[0])
    @help_window.hide
  end
 
  # OVERWRITE
  def create_dummy_window
    wx = Graphics.width - 304
    wy = @command_window.y + @command_window.height
    wh = Graphics.height - wy - @gold_window.height * 2
    ww = Graphics.width - wx
    @dummy_window = Window_Base.new(wx, wy, ww, wh)
    @dummy_window.viewport = @viewport
  end
 
  # OVERWRITE
  def create_buy_window
    wy = @dummy_window.y
    wh = @dummy_window.height
    @buy_window = CSCA_Window_SkillShopBuy.new(0, wy, wh, @goods)
    @buy_window.viewport = @viewport
    @buy_window.help_window = @help_window
    @buy_window.status_window = @status_window
    @buy_window.desc_window = @desc_window
    @buy_window.hide
    @buy_window.set_handler(:ok,     method(:on_buy_ok))
    @buy_window.set_handler(:cancel, method(:on_buy_cancel))
    @buy_window.x = Graphics.width - @buy_window.width
  end
 
  # OVERWRITE
  def create_status_window
    wx = @dummy_window.x
    wy = @dummy_window.y + @dummy_window.height
    ww = @dummy_window.width
    wh = Graphics.height - @dummy_window.height - @dummy_window.y
    @status_window = CSCA_Window_SkillShopStatus.new(wx, wy, ww, wh)
    @status_window.viewport = @viewport
    @status_window.hide
    @status_window.set_handler(:ok,     method(:on_number_ok))
    @status_window.set_handler(:cancel, method(:on_number_cancel))
  end

    @command_window.activate

    @status_window.hide
    @status_window.item = nil
    @help_window.clear
    if @has_shopped == true
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[3])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    else
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[4])

    show_talk
    @has_shopped = false

    @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)

    @dkey.opacity = 255

    @desc_window.height = @buy_window.height

    $game_party.lose_gold(buying_price)
    $game_actors[actor.id].learn_skill(skill.id)
    @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[1])
    show_talk

    @help_window.hide

    @help_window.show

    other_poses if $game_system.shop_spose != nil
  end

      if Input.trigger?(Galv_Shopkeeper::DETAILS_KEY) || Input.trigger?(:B)
        @buy_window.show.activate
        RPG::SE.new(Galv_Shopkeeper::SE2[0], Galv_Shopkeeper::SE2[1], Galv_Shopkeeper::SE2[2]).play
        @desc_window.show_off
        @desc_window.hide
        @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
      end
    elsif @buy_window.active
      if Input.trigger?(Galv_Shopkeeper::DETAILS_KEY)
        return if @buy_window.item.nil?
        @buy_window.hide.deactivate
        @desc_window.refresh(@buy_window.item,0)
        @shoptime = 0
        RPG::SE.new(Galv_Shopkeeper::SE1[0], Galv_Shopkeeper::SE1[1], Galv_Shopkeeper::SE1[2]).play
        @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::SHOW_DETAILS) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
        hide_talk
        @desc_window.show
      end
    end
  end
 
  def other_poses
    case $game_system.shop_spose
    when 0
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[6])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::CANT_BUY) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    when 1
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[7])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::CANT_SELL) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    when 2
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[8])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::MAX_ITEMS) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    when 3
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[10])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::NO_DETAILS) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    when 4
      @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[11])
      @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::SOLD_OUT) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    end
    show_talk
    @shoptime = Galv_Shopkeeper::FRAME_TIME
    $game_system.shop_spose = nil
  end
 
  def return_scene
    @talk_window.set_text($game_system.shop_talk[9])
    @keeper.bitmap = Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper + Galv_Shopkeeper::FAREWELL) rescue Cache.picture($game_system.shopkeeper)
    show_talk
    @shoptime = Galv_Shopkeeper::FRAME_TIME
    @leave_shop = true
    $game_system.shop_selected = 0
  end
 
  def terminate
    super
    @keeper.dispose
    @keeper.bitmap.dispose
    @shopback.dispose
    @dkey.bitmap.dispose
    @dkey.dispose
  end

class CSCA_Window_SkillShopStatus < Window_Selectable
 
  def set(skill, price)
    @skill = skill
    @price = price
    refresh
  end

  def initialize(x, y, width, height)
    super(x, y, width, height)
    @walk = 0
    @step = 0
    @animtime = 0
    @e_images = {}
    @skill = nil
    @page_index = 0
    refresh
    select(0)
  end
 
  def item_max
    @data ? @data.size : 1
  end
 
  def item
    @data[index]
  end
 
  def item=(item)
    @skill = item
    refresh
  end

  def current_item_enabled?
    enable?(@data[index])
  end

  def enable?(actor)
    for i in 0...actor.skills.size
      if actor.skills[i] == @skill
        return false
      end
    end
    for i in 0...actor.csca_learnable_skills.size
      unless @skill.nil?
        if actor.csca_learnable_skills[i] == @skill.id
          return true
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end

  def refresh
    contents.clear
    make_item_list
    create_contents
    draw_all_items
  end

  def status_members
    $game_party.members[@page_index * page_size, page_size]
  end
 
  def col_max
    return Galv_Shopkeeper::ACTORS_SHOWN
  end
 
  def make_item_list
    @data = []
    $game_party.members.each do |actor|
      item = actor
      if !item.nil?
        @data.push(item)
      end
    end
  end

  def draw_item(index)
    item = @data[index]
    rect = item_rect(index)
    draw_equip_info(Galv_Shopkeeper::ACTORS_X + 5, 40)
  end
 
  def item_rect(index)
    rect = Rect.new
    rect.width = item_width
    rect.height = item_height - spacing / 2
    rect.x = index % col_max * item_width + (index * Galv_Shopkeeper::ACTORS_SPACE) + Galv_Shopkeeper::ACTORS_X - (index * 40) - 4
    rect.y = index / col_max * item_height + spacing / 2 - 4
    rect
  end

  def item_width
    return 40
  end

  def item_height
    return 60
  end
 
  # OVERWRITE
  def draw_equip_info(x, y)
    status_members.each_with_index do |actor, i|
      draw_actor_equip_info(x + (i * Galv_Shopkeeper::ACTORS_SPACE), y, actor)
    end
  end
 
  # OVERWRITE
  def page_size
    return Galv_Shopkeeper::ACTORS_SHOWN
  end
 
  # OVERWRITE
  def draw_actor_equip_info(x, y, actor)
    draw_character(actor.character_name, actor.character_index, x + 10, y + 11, enable?(actor))
  end
  
  def draw_character(character_name, character_index, x, y, enabled = false)
    return unless character_name
    bitmap = Cache.character(character_name)
    sign = character_name[/^[\!\$]./]
    if sign && sign.include?('$')
      cw = bitmap.width / 3
      ch = bitmap.height / 4
    else
      cw = bitmap.width / 12
      ch = bitmap.height / 8
    end
    n = character_index
    step = 0
    step = @walk if enabled
    src_rect = Rect.new((n%4*3+1+step)*cw, (n/4*4)*ch, cw, ch)
    contents.blt(x - cw / 2, y - ch, bitmap, src_rect)
  end

  def ani_motion
    @animtime += 1
    if @animtime == 10
      case @walk
      when 1; @walk -= 1
      when -1; @walk += 1
      when 0
        if @step == 1
          @walk = -1
          @step = 0
        else
          @walk = 1
          @step = 1
        end
      end
      refresh
      @animtime = 0
    end
  end

  def update
    super
    ani_motion
  end
end

    dy += 24 if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::USE_SPACES
    @item.effects.each do |set|
      case set.code
      when 11 #---HP---

        word = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::TEXT_HP
        icon = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ICON_HP
      when 12 #---MP---
        count += 1
        word = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::TEXT_MP
        icon = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ICON_MP
      when 13 #---TP---

        word = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::TEXT_TP
        icon = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ICON_TP

        next
      end

      num2 = 0

        text2 = sprintf("%d", num2)

        text = sprintf("%d", num1)
        text = "+" + text

        text = text + "%"
      elsif num2 != 0

        text = "+" + text

        next if set.code == 0
        next if set.data_id == 0

        elsif set.code == 22

          icon = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ICON_MAT
        when 5 #---MDF---

          icon = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ICON_MDF
        when 6 #---AGI---
          word = Vocab::param(set.data_id)
          icon = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ICON_AGI

          text = "+" + text + " turns"
        end

        change_color(system_color)

      end
    end
##########################################################################
    if R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ITEM_STATS
      @item.effects.each do |set|
        case set.code
        when 42 #---Grow Stat---
          buff = R2_Skill_Shop_Settings::ITEM_STAT_TEXT
        else

        end
        case set.data_id
        when 0 #---HP---
